breakdown.description: Lumped-capacitance method is requested even though Bi=5 violates the small-Biot validity condition.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains Bi=5 and proceeds to use the lumped-capacitance method without any correction or warning. The ground truth requires either correcting Bi to 0.05 (satisfying Bi < 0.1) or recommending a spatially resolved transient conduction model for Bi=5. The agent did neither—it repeated the original error verbatim.
